description: Web search API / SERP results: raw web and news results from Brave's independent index in any language and country, with title, URL, description, age and extra snippets (headline, source and age for news). Filter by country, language and freshness (day, week, month, year). Results, not an answer: pick what to read next with extract.page. Input: query; optional country, language, count, freshness, news. $0.25 per call.
name: hubvibe_search_results
title: Web and news results in any language and country (Brave index)
